title: Historical decision card
description: One historical decision, written as a short structured card for the cache-friendly prompt prefix assembled by gen/prompt.py. Cards teach the shape of a decision under ambiguity — what was known, what was chosen, and why — not the content of any scenario the model will be scored on. Every card must come from the allowed list in docs/quarantine.md; nothing from the quarantined replays or the held-out year. This schema is a draft local to specs/drafts/ and is not a contract; a human promoting the bank may fold it into contracts/.

spec_version.description: The spec-pool version this bank ships with, so a prompt prefix is reproducible.

date.description: Free text, because several of these are ranges or campaigns rather than a single day.

decision_maker.description: The seat, not a psychological portrait: what post the person held and what authority it carried.

analogous_seats.description: Which seats on this board face a decision of the same shape. Used to select cards per seat when the prefix budget is tight.

information_available.description: What the decision-maker actually had at the moment of choice, including its latency and its confidence. Never what was learned afterwards.

why.description: The reasoning as far as the public record supports it, plus the incentive structure the seat sat inside. Where motive is contested, say so.

transfer.description: What this card is in the bank to teach: the generalisable move, not the incident.

ladder_rung.description: The rung(s) on contracts/action_schema.json#/x-action-ladder the historical decision maps onto.

contested.description: What the public record does not establish. Required in spirit for every card whose motive is disputed.

sources.description: Open sources a human can check. Not sent to the model.
